pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Cloudy Temple.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Cumulonimbus has a brief protected interval after a hit and a per-hit damage cap. When the golem permits breaking, a fully charged axe hit damages its shell. The laser and recovery provide different windows: leave the beam line first, then use an available attack.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Air Rune, Atmospheric Boots. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Magical Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
